107a11f27dc5d9088215a4c30e8c678d1f510b48.digest:
Primary focus is packages/coding-agent/; "agent" refers to that package, not the assistant. Import catalog values from @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog/<module>; type-only imports from @oh-my-pi/pi-ai are permitted. Never hard-code model/provider conditionals in TypeScript—policy lives in the KDL tree at packages/catalog/src/compat/rules/, built with bun run gen:compat. Never edit generated files (models.json, rules.json); fix the KDL, descriptor, mapper, or generator source.

GitHub: show proposed comments/issues and obtain confirmation before posting. Authorisation to address PR feedback permits drafting replies, not posting. Resolve threads only after verifying the fix and approving a factual reply. Creating or editing a PR requires reading CONTRIBUTING.md and the template, securing the contributor's own description, and reading back the published body.

Style: no any unless unavoidable; ban ReturnType<>, inline, and dynamic-type imports. Star-export barrels. Use #private; no access-modifier keywords except constructor parameters. Prefer Promise.withResolvers(). Prompts are static .md files via Handlebars, imported with { type: "text" }. Judge questions: one JSON per feature through judgeQuestions()/renderQuestion(). Workers re-enter the CLI via workerHostEntry(); new kinds need a cli.ts dispatch entry plus the smoke probe. Grep for existing helpers first; extend central modules. Git/jj only via @oh-my-pi/pi-natives/vcs. TUI sanitization—replaceTabs, truncateToWidth, shortenPath, PREVIEW_LIMITS—applies to every render path including errors and diffs. Streaming previews flow through decodeStreamedToolArgs on both live and rebuilt paths.

Runtime: use Bun APIs ($`cmd`, Bun.file, Bun.write, Bun.sleep, bun:sqlite, Bun.stringWidth, Bun.wrapAnsi); namespace-import node:*; prefer node:fs/promises. No shell-spawn when a direct API exists. Log via logger from pi-utils whenever TUI, RPC, SDK, or workers may be active; console.* only for standalone exiting CLI.

Commands: never commit unless asked; bun check not tsc; bun run test:rs not cargo test. Merge format: "Merge PR #N: <subject> (@author)". Rust: never pair split-debuginfo off with debug-info-enabled profiles.

Tests defend an externally observable contract. Banned: source-text greps, mock.module(), tautologies, static echoes, passthrough assertions. Full-suite safe via per-test spyOn and restoreAllMocks. Parameterised rows need distinct branches.

Changelog: one-line user-facing entries under Unreleased; released sections immutable; attribute internally with issue links, externally with PR plus author. Release via bun run release.

Ecosystem: 58 submodules in 7 domain groups, each an independent repo. Agent context cascades umbrella, group, submodule; nearest .omp/AGENTS.md preempts upward walk. .ckrefs.toml entries inject under <ckrefs-cascade>; prefer ck_* tools over filesystem search.

Bootstrap: load Codekeeper Skill and Hindsight Memory at session start. LiteLLM CCR replaces large outputs with "Retrieve more: hash=" markers—stubs, not content. Call mcp__headroom_mcp_headroom_retrieve(hash) before acting on partial data. Proactively compress outputs of 300+ lines via the compress tool. Entries expire at 24 hours; no fallback retrieval exists.
